caveats.statement: Player_Attributes and Team_Attributes have multiple records per player/team over time; using the table directly without filtering by date or aggregating can lead to incorrect results.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT player_api_id, COUNT(*) FROM Player_Attributes GROUP BY player_api_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 LIMIT 5;

caveats.statement: The 'season' column in Match uses formats like '2015/2016', not just the year, so filtering by year alone may miss records.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT DISTINCT season FROM Match LIMIT 10;

caveats.statement: Player names may have duplicates or variations; filtering by player_name alone might return multiple players.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT player_name, COUNT(*) FROM Player GROUP BY player_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 LIMIT 5;

caveats.statement: Team_Attributes and Player_Attributes have dates that may not align with match dates; joining without date consideration can produce incorrect analysis.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Team_Attributes WHERE date NOT IN (SELECT date FROM Match);
